integrity: Full all-circumference proof uses a complete finite graph whose critical SCC facts are reproduced from standalone standard-library code. Cell-level brute force for small circumferences corroborates but does not prove the all-length statement. No third-party validation.
scientific_limitations: Only deterministic binary north-east-center majority on the labelled four-row periodic strip and primitive temporal period three; other periods, higher widths, noise and transients are not classified. The full text of a plausible 1997 Toom ground-state comparator was inaccessible; unindexed equivalents remain a priority risk.
title: A three-column resonance and temporal-three rigidity in four-row Toom dynamics
